title: AI Research Intern (3D Human Motion under Physical Constraints)
company: University of Alberta | Vision and Learning Lab
description: At Prof. Li Cheng's Vision and Learning Lab. I designed a differentiable optimisation layer at the output of the network, so that the pose it produces is physically feasible.
detail:
At Prof. Li Cheng's Vision and Learning Lab.

I designed a differentiable optimisation layer placed at the output of the network. The network predicts a pose, the layer returns the nearest physically feasible one. Floor contact is a hard constraint there, not a penalty added to the loss. The gradient passes through the layer by implicit differentiation, so the whole thing trains end to end. The model is a permutation-equivariant transformer with attention factorised over people, joints and time.
